title: Gotrade Daily: Fed Hikes Rates, 10Y Yield Tops 5%
summary: The Fed raised rates for the first time since 2023 and the 10-year yield topped 5%. Here is tonight's watchlist and the catalysts to watch.
body_markdown:
### Power and nuclear names rally on AI electricity demand


Utilities and nuclear names were a bright spot. GE Vernova ([GEV](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/gev/) ) crushed it, Forgent Power jumped 11% on a swing to profit, and the Vistra ([VST](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/vst/) ) versus Constellation debate over the better AI-power bet is live again. Electricity demand for AI data centers remains the engine here.


## Pre-Market Pulse 📊


US futures direction still needs confirming into tonight's open. Beyond the watchlist, Snap's after-hours signal was mixed following the Specs launch, while AI-memory names such as Micron stayed in the conversation. Homebuilder reads like Lennar are worth a look as an early reaction to the hike.


## Macro Note 📝


The 10Y above 5% is the anchor tonight. Gold eased to around $4,461 an ounce, WTI crude held elevated near $105 a barrel, and the dollar firmed against Asian currencies. Central banks are already moving: Hong Kong followed with its first hike in over three years, while the BOJ and Taiwan face the same pressure. The read-through for Asian FX is worth watching.


## Conclusion


Tonight is less about a single stock and more about the price of money changing. The Fed's hike and a 10Y above 5% pressure rate-sensitive valuations, but they also open stock-specific stories like FedEx earnings and the AI-power rally.


The healthy move is to separate the macro noise from the per-stock opportunities. Build your watchlist, mark the levels you care about, and let tonight's data guide the next step.
